usages.usage: 表示使某人產生某種感受或狀態
examples: So, I decided one day to 《make》 a video, specifically a Tik Tok, where I spoke slowly and I 《made》 lots of hand gestures at a speed that anyone could understand using hand gesture.

usages.usage: 在 get ready/get lost 等搭配中表示「變得、進入某狀態」
examples: For 4 years because I 《get》 lazy sometimes.

breakdowns.sentence: Hello and welcome back to my Slow English podcast.
breakdowns.translation: 大家好，歡迎回到我的慢速英文podcast。

points.label: to 不定詞
points.note: 用來表示目的、補語或接在特定動詞後。

breakdowns.sentence: This podcast is for you to practice your English listening while being engaged in real life stories about me.
breakdowns.translation: 這個podcast是為了讓你練習英語聽力，同時參與關於我的真實故事。

points.label: while + V-ing / 子句
points.note: 表示兩個動作同時發生。

breakdowns.sentence: And that was actually a huge inspiration for me to start with my Slow English podcast.
breakdowns.translation: 這其實是我開始製作慢速英語podcast的巨大靈感。

points.label: that 引導名詞子句或關係子句
points.note: that 用來補充說明前面的想法或名詞。

breakdowns.sentence: And when you don't feel progress or achievement, when you don't feel like you're improving at something, it's hard to keep giving your best at improving.
breakdowns.translation: 當你感覺不到進步或成就時，當你感覺自己在某件事上沒有進步時，你就很難繼續盡最大努力去進步。

points.label: when 時間子句
points.note: 用 when 說明事情發生的時間或情境。

breakdowns.sentence: So many people would realize that they actually do understand English.
breakdowns.translation: 很多人會意識到他們其實懂英語。

points.label: would 表示假設或委婉語氣
points.note: 用來談假設、過去習慣或較委婉的說法。

breakdowns.sentence: Ers in a way where you could understand even if you had never studied English because body language speaks much louder than words.
breakdowns.translation: 即使你從未學過英語，也可以理解，因為肢體語言比語言更有效。

points.label: if 條件句
points.note: 用 if 帶出條件，再說明在此條件下的結果。

breakdowns.sentence: She used to be obsessed with learning Chinese.
breakdowns.translation: 她曾經沉迷於學習中文。

points.label: used to + 原形動詞
points.note: 表示過去常做或過去曾經如此，現在可能不同。

breakdowns.sentence: Imagine if I have been learning Chinese for 4 years and I can barely form a full sentence.
breakdowns.translation: 想像一下，如果我學了四年中文，我幾乎無法說出一個完整的句子。

points.label: 現在完成進行式
points.note: 表示動作從過去開始，一直持續到現在。
